summary: Full backend + frontend testing for Casa Connect. 23/23 pytest tests pass. All frontend flows in the review request verified via Playwright (landing, listings + filters, property detail + anonymous inquiry, signup->dashboard, admin login->/admin, new property create+save, admin inquiries tab, guest ProtectedRoute redirect, user login, favorite add + Favorites tab).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 593 lines - consider splitting into auth/properties/inquiries modules if it grows further.

CORS uses allow_origins=['*'] together with allow_credentials=True; browsers reject that combination for cookie-bearing requests. Cookie auth still works here because the frontend also falls back to Authorization: Bearer, but the cookie won't actually be set on cross-origin fetches. Consider explicit origins if you rely on httpOnly cookies.
Anonymous inquiry endpoint (POST /api/inquiries) has no rate limiting or captcha - trivially spammable.
